title: Singly
summary: SIN'GLY, adverb 1. Individually; particularly; as, to make men singly and personally good. 2. Only; by himself. Look thee, 'tis so, thou singly honest man. 3. Without partners, companions or associate

inlines.v: SIN'GLY, adverb 1. Individually; particularly; as, to make men singly and personally good. 2. Only; by himself. Look thee, 'tis so, thou singly honest man. 3. Without partners, companions or associates; as, to attack another singly At ombre singly to decide their doom. 4. Honestly; sincerely.
